color.$description: The grey text colours (foreground, card, popover, secondary, muted, disabled and the text on the primary fill) alias the kit's text tokens in packages/ui/src/system/styles/design-rework.css, written as {rw.fg.*}: one grey system in both themes (Lukas, 15 October 2026). Info is the accent (Lukas, 4 November 2026; coherence audit D13): info aliases the accent fill, {rw.bg.accent}, and info-foreground the accent text, {rw.fg.accent}, so the info glyphs, dots and markers take the accent the info Badge and the info Alert's rim already took. The other status text colours keep their own values. Focus is the kit's focus edge (cleanup, 4 November 2026): focus aliases {rw.border.focus}, the accent at full strength that every focus ring and active field edge of the kit draws; it was Tailwind's blue-500. Primary is the accent too (cleanup, 4 November 2026): primary aliases the accent fill, {rw.bg.accent}, and primary-foreground the text on accent fills, {rw.fg.on-accent}, so the Task Calendar's today and every primary utility take the accent; primary was the navy brand primitive of the system core. The hover colours are the fills the Buttons draw under the pointer (Lukas, 4 November 2026): primary-hover aliases {rw.bg.accent-hover}, the accent Button's, destructive-hover {rw.bg.destructive-hover}, the destructive Button's, and control-hover {rw.bg.control-hover}, the default Button's, each its fill under its hover layer in every theme; they were Tailwind's blue-500 and blue-100, red-500 and red-100, and neutral-100 and neutral-800, which nothing read.
